name: Remove Fatigue, Mass Greater
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level bloodlord 5, cleric/oracle 5, druid 5, inquisitor 5, shaman 5

Target one creature/level, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

This spell functions as greater remove fatigue, except as noted above.
